answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, capped per identity per epoch, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The sonnet holds work receipts rather than names, so the mesa of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. By the gale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
